message: needs alt: describe the image, or write alt="" if it’s decorative (WCAG 1.1.1).
<input type="image"> needs alt that says what the button does (WCAG 1.1.1).
<area href> needs alt that names the link target (WCAG 1.1.1).
role="img" needs a name: add aria-label or aria-labelledby (WCAG 1.1.1).
